channel.title: Homestead Guides
channel.description: Free, research-backed homesteading how-tos for backyard homesteaders, sourced from university extension research.

item.title: How to Build a Family Emergency Binder: Documents, Water Math & a Livestock Plan
item.description: What actually belongs in the binder, the water math most people get wrong, the power-outage food-safety clock, and the livestock evacuation plan most templates leave out — from Ready.gov, FoodSafety.gov, and USDA.

item.title: Frost Dates & Succession Planting: A Beginner's Guide to Timing Your Vegetable Garden
item.description: The exact weeks-before/after-frost chart by crop, and the two-week succession-planting rule that keeps a garden producing all season instead of all at once — from Purdue, Penn State, Missouri, and Maryland Extension.

item.title: Baking Bread at Home: Yeast, Sourdough & No-Knead for Beginners
item.description: The real temperature numbers for yeast bread, a 5-day sourdough starter timeline, the no-knead method, and which flour to reach for — from University of Kentucky, Clemson, Iowa State, and Arkansas Extension.

item.title: How to Label Your Pantry & Canning Jars: Dates, Shelf Life & Rotation Explained
item.description: What "best if used by" actually means, how long home-canned jars really last, real canned-goods storage times, and the FIFO system that keeps a pantry in order — from Penn State, Texas A&M AgriLife, and Utah State Extension.

item.title: Winterizing the Homestead: A Beginner's Checklist for Animals, Pipes & Power
item.description: How much more chickens eat and drink in the cold, the cattle energy rule that surprises most beginners, frozen-pipe prevention, and safe generator placement — from NC State, UGA, Oklahoma State, and CDC.

item.title: Building a Wood-Fired Cob Oven: A Beginner's Guide to Earthen Oven Construction
item.description: The three layers that actually make a cob oven work, the door-height rule that decides how well it drafts, a safe curing-fire schedule, and clearance-to-combustibles basics.

item.title: Building a Chicken Tractor: A Beginner's Guide to Mobile Coops
item.description: Real space numbers for broilers vs. layers, why the daily move matters, and the predator-proofing details a lightweight pen actually needs — from Oregon State Extension and the Government of Alberta.

item.title: Fermenting Vegetables at Home: A Beginner's Guide to Sauerkraut & Pickles
item.description: The tested salt ratios, fermentation temperature and time, and the real signs that tell you a batch went wrong — from the National Center for Home Food Preservation and university extension.

item.title: Composting Toilets for Off-Grid Living: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: How a composting toilet actually works, the carbon and moisture balance that keeps it from failing, why most home units can't fully sterilize waste, and the legal checks to make before you install one — from Washington State DOH, West Virginia University, and the EPA.

item.title: Building a Backyard Chicken Coop: A Beginner's Guide to Space, Nest Boxes & Predator-Proofing
item.description: Real square-footage numbers for coop and run space, nest box and roost sizing, and the predator-proofing details (hardware cloth, buried wire aprons) that actually keep a flock safe — from Penn State and Oregon State Extension.

item.title: Building Your Own Beehive: A Beginner's Guide to Langstroth Hive Construction
item.description: Box dimensions, bee space, materials, weatherproofing, and hive-stand siting for building a Langstroth beehive from scratch — with real numbers from extension and apiary-association sources.

item.title: Building a Goat & Sheep Loafing Shed: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: How much shed space goats and sheep actually need, how to site a three-sided loafing shed, and the bedding and feeder-space numbers that keep a small flock or herd healthy — from university extension research.

item.title: Growing a Backyard Berry Patch: Blueberries, Strawberries & Raspberries for Beginners
item.description: The soil-pH mistake that kills blueberries for good, how to pick the right strawberry type for your space, and the raspberry pruning rule that decides whether you get a crop this year — from Penn State, Oregon State, and University of Minnesota Extension.

item.title: Home Food Dehydrating for Beginners: Drying Fruits, Vegetables & Jerky Safely
item.description: The real temperature to dry at, why fruit needs a dip first, the storage step most beginners skip, and the one extra safety step jerky needs that vegetables don't — from NCHFP, Penn State, and USDA.

item.title: Season Extension for Your Garden: Hoop Houses vs. Cold Frames for Beginners
item.description: A cold frame nudges your harvest a few weeks either direction; a hoop house can add two months on each end of the season. How to tell which one your garden actually needs, from Oklahoma State, Iowa State, and NC State Extension.

item.title: Smoking & Curing Meat at Home: A Beginner's Guide to Safe Ham, Bacon & Sausage
item.description: Why the cure, not the smoke, is what actually makes cured meat safe — exact ratios, curing time by thickness, and why beginners should master hot smoking before ever trying cold smoking.

item.title: Keeping a Family Milk Cow: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Jersey or Holstein, how much land and barn space a cow actually needs, real water/hay numbers, and why the dry period before calving matters — from university extension research.

item.title: Rainwater Harvesting for the Garden: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: How much water your roof actually collects, first-flush diverters, safe storage tank materials, and how to use harvested rain safely on food crops — from EPA and university extension research.

item.title: Backyard Composting for Beginners: Turn Scraps Into Rich Garden Soil
item.description: The real carbon:nitrogen ratio, browns vs. greens, the pile size that actually heats up, and how to fix a smelly or cold pile — sourced from Oregon State, Washington State, and Cornell.

item.title: How to Start Raising Sheep at Home: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Wool breed or hair breed, the fencing that actually holds a sheep, the copper mineral trap that can kill a flock, and lambing basics — from university extension research.

item.title: Root Cellar Storage for Beginners: How to Keep Your Harvest All Winter
item.description: No canning jar required: learn the real temperature/humidity zones, curing steps, and storage life for potatoes, onions, carrots, squash, and more, from university extension research.

item.title: How to Raise Pigs for Meat at Home: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Thinking about raising a feeder pig or two for the freezer? Learn real space, fencing, feed-by-weight, temperature, and timeline numbers from university extension research.

item.title: How to Start an Herb Garden: A Beginner's Guide to Growing, Harvesting, and Drying Herbs
item.description: Thinking about growing your own herbs? Learn sun and soil needs, the easiest herbs to start with, correct watering, and how to harvest and dry a real harvest, from university extension research.

item.title: How to Start Raising Backyard Turkeys: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Thinking about raising turkeys? Learn broad-breasted vs. heritage breed choice, brooder temperature schedules, space by age, and the one rule that keeps turkeys and chickens apart, from university extension research.

item.title: How to Start Raising Backyard Dairy Goats: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Thinking about keeping dairy goats? Learn breed choice, housing and fencing, feeding and the copper mineral trap, and kidding timing from university extension research.

item.title: Home Canning for Beginners: Water-Bath vs. Pressure Canning Explained
item.description: A beginner's guide to safe home canning: why acidity decides water-bath vs. pressure canning, jar/lid prep, headspace, and altitude adjustments, from university extension sources.

item.title: How to Raise Meat Rabbits at Home: A Beginner's Guide
item.description: Thinking about raising rabbits for meat? Learn cage size by weight, feeding amounts, breeding and kindling timing, and health warning signs from university extension research.

item.title: Companion Planting for Vegetable Gardens: What Actually Works
item.description: Which companion planting pairings are backed by real research, and which are garden folklore? A beginner's guide to what to plant together — and what to keep apart.

item.title: How to Start Beekeeping: Beginner Guide to Your First Hive
item.description: Thinking about your first beehive? Learn hive types, how to get bees, startup costs, the first-year calendar, and varroa mite basics from extension research.

item.title: How to Start Raising Backyard Ducks: Beginner Guide
item.description: Thinking about backyard ducks? Learn breed choice, brooder temperatures, water requirements, and feed-by-age numbers before your ducklings arrive.

item.title: How to Start a Backyard Chicken Flock: Beginner Guide
item.description: Starting backyard chickens? Learn coop space, brooder temps, feed types by age, predator-proofing, and when you'll get your first eggs.

item.title: How to Start a Backyard Apple Orchard: Beginner's Guide
item.description: Planning your first apple orchard? Learn chill hours, pollination, rootstock spacing, and planting steps every beginner needs.
